As can be seen from the results, simultaneous removal of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and NO by using NaClO/ammonia solution is available.

articleTitle: Zinc Distribution in Sediments of the Shaxi River
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: For the surficial sediments sampled from the Shaxi River in Sanming, Fujian Province, China, the distribution and fraction of heavy metal zinc in surficial sediments were researched. The microwave digestion result showed that the concentration of zincin surficial sediments ranged from 568 mg/kg to 2126 mg/kg. The results of modified BCR sequential extraction procedure showed that heavy metal zinc in the surficial sediment was mainly associated with residual and acid soluble fractions. The fractions of zinc sampled near the drain were in the order of residual > acid soluble > oxidizable > reducible > water soluble fraction, and in the order of residual > reducible > acid soluble > oxidizable >>water soluble fraction in samples away from the drain. The results indicated that the concentration and fraction of pollutant zinc were significantly correlative to the drain of some iron and steel factory around the Shaxi River, which varied obviously with the downstream distance increasing to the drain. The acid soluble and oxidizable fractions decreased with the downstream distance increasing to the drain of iron and steel factory, however, the residual and reducible fractions increased with the distance increasing.

articleTitle: Research of Information Management System of Building Energy Conservation Inspect and Record
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Extensive investigations for the inspect and record of Building Energy Conservation (BEC)have been in the four representative cities of thermal efficiency sub areas of China, existing problems of current BEC inspect and record in China are analyzed. Based on the actual situation of the BEC inspect, the solution is proposed. Based on the model mentioned above, the Information Management System for BEC item inspect and record suiting for each thermal efficiency sub areas features, which consists of system login and system management module, construction-related units module, inspect entries module, construction project information module, item inspect module, is developed. This system owns good software extensibility, clear interface, simple operation for the clients and so on.

articleTitle: Research on the Harmful of Coal Solid Waste and Its Recycling Technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Coal gangue is solid waste, which is all kinds of rocks and residual abandoned coal produced in the process of mining and washing in machining, its composition is very complicated. The paper is based on the data collection and field investigation, and discusses the harm of coal solid waste from different angles, especially the harm of spontaneous combustion gangue, it can make the air pollution of the environment, water quality and soil damage, the collapse, and take up valuable land resources and other hazards. Based on the collection of coal solid waste samples from different parts, we analyze the samples of material composition in detail by experimental methods, and point out the importance of the technology for coal solid waste recycling, it has strategic significance for making circular economy, reducing resource depletion, and realizing the coordinated development of the economy and the environment. At the same time, through research, we can enable the companies to realize the dangers of coal solid waste, and its available ingredients, so as to speedup the solid waste recycling quick, healthy and efficient development.

articleTitle: Estimation of Rate Constants for Radical Degradation of Aromatic Pollutants by Density Functional Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: In present study, rate constants for radical degradation of 52 aromatic pollutants were predicted with QSAR model. The parameters of model were obtained from optimized calculation of aromatic pollutants that were carried out at B3LYP/6-311G** level with density functional theory. Then, different molecular descriptors were taken as theoretical descriptors to establish the QSAR models by partial least square regression analysis. The novel QSAR model contains four variables, of which square regression coefficient is 0.82, standard deviation is 0.10. The QSAR model obtained reveal the reliability and good predictivity for the prediction of the rate constants of aromatic pollutants.

articleTitle: Textile Wastewater Advanced Treatment Using Combination of Ozonation and Two-Stage Biological Treatment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: In this work, the advanced treatment of the biologically treated wastewater of a textile plant using combination of ozonation and two-stage biological aerated filter (BAF) was studied. Comparing different ozone dosing methods, it was found that the integrated device including ozonation and BAF, allowed a higher COD (chemical oxygen demand) and color reduction. Comparing different treatment processes, it was found the combination of the integrated device and up-flow biological aerated filter allowed a higher pollutant reduction. After the ozonation and two-stage biological treatment, an effluent was obtained with the average COD of 26.7 mg/L, turbidity of 4.2 NTU, SS(suspended solid) of 2.0 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen of 0.6 mg/L and color of 2 degree.

articleTitle: Effect on Deposition of the Three Gorges Reservoir (TGR) Caused by Advancing the Impounding Time after Flood Period
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Based on one-dimensional, unsteady flow and non uniform sediment mathematical model, through analyzing the change of the deposition developing process and deposition amount of the Three Gorges Reservoir (TGR) that is caused by advancing the impounding time after flood period, a conclusion is made that the reasonable advancing the impounding time after flood period will accelerate the deposition developing process of the Three Gorges Reservoir(TGR), and advancing the impounding time more, the deposition develop faster. However, advancing the impounding time after flood period will not change the final silt-stable state, the Sediment deposition volume and distribution is similar. It indicates that reasonable advancing the impounding time after flood period is acceptable.

Author Keywords: advancing the impounding time after flood period

articleTitle: Adsorption of NO (or NH3) +O2 over the Commercial SCR Catalyst Characterized by EPR
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The adsorption of reactants over the commerciallized SCR catalyst surface was investigated by EPR, as well as the influence of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O and SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. The results showed that the V<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup> over the catalyst could be oxidized under NO + O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> atmosphere, and NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> was adsorbed on Brönsted acid sites. The amounts of V<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup> and super oxide ions were promoted at the presence of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O and SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> after adsorption. However, the intensity of Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> decreased when H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O and SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> were present, indicating the favorable effect of Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> for anti-poisoning.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of "Three Zones" Partition of Spontaneous Combustion in Goaf under the Moving Coordinates
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Coal spontaneous combustion is the main disaster of coal mine, furthermore most of them happen in the goaf. Distribution of "three zones" of spontaneous combustion reflects the state of oxidation temperature increasing in goaf, which is the base of spontaneous combustion prevention and control in goaf. This paper analyzed critical value of the "threezones" partition methods in goaf which are based on air leakage velocity and oxygen concentration, propose a new method of combining these two indexes. The authors simulate and calculate the distribution the velocity of air leakage and oxygen concentration in goaf of 2108 fully mechanized caving face of gucheng coal mine in Shandong by used the established model of spontaneous combustion in goaf under the moving coordinates, partition the "three zones". The results provide a theoretical basis for prediction and prevention of spontaneous combustion in goaf.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Research of Deformation Failure Law Regularity for Overlying Strata
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: According to the nonlinear numerical simulation of the surrounding rock deformation-failure with the advancing of 1301 full-mechanize face in Dongda coal mine, Pseudo-dynamic numerical simulation was carried out to analyze the stress distribution and the deformation-failure. The results show that with the advancing of working face the stress in seam floor came three stages: first, stress increased before mining, second, stress decreased after mining, third, stress restored, and they appeared every 18 meters; the floor critical failure depth is 3 meters; the stress concentration factor is 1.35.

articleTitle: Study on the Determination of Trace Lead by Spectrophotometry after Flotation Separation with Ternary Association Complex System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The paper presents a novel method for the flotation separation of Pb2+ with ternary association complex system prior to the determination by spectrophotometry. The effects of different parameters, such as the dosages of KI and hexa decyl trim ethyl ammonium bromide (CTMAB), various salts and acidity etc. on the flotation yield of Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> have been investigated to select the experimental conditions. The possible flotation mechanism of Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> was discussed. The results showed that by controlling pH1.0, in the presence of 1.0 g NaNO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, when the dosage of 0.1 mol·L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> KI solution was 1.00 mL and 0.01 mol·L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> CTMAB solution was 0.50 mL respectively, the water-insoluble ternary association complex of (CTMAB)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>(PbI<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>) which produced by Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> and I<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>, CTMAB cation (CTMAB<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>) floated above water phase and liquid-solid phases were formed with clear interface, while Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>, Co<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>, Ni<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>, Zn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>, Mn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> and Al<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> could not be floated, so Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> was floated quantitatively at pH1.0. Thereby, the quantitative separation of Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> from the above metal ions could be achieved. A new method of determination of trace lead by flotation separation was established. The proposed method has been successfully applied to the determination of Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> in the sample of synthetic water and the flotation yield was 96.3%~106.6%.

articleTitle: Study on the Inaccuracies of Air Velocity Measured by Pitots with Different Outer Diameter in a Air Duct
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The inaccuracies for air velocity measured by Pitots with different diameter have been demonstrated by several experiments. It is defined that the measurement ranges of air velocity by Pitots with different outer diameter. Experiments show that: measurements by Pitot are larger than the true values. The measurement error of air velocity will be smaller if using the Pitot with a smaller outer diameter. The simplified function of correction coefficient and ratio of diameters is deduced by theoretical analysis. The maximum error of correction coefficients is 0.94%, which gained by the simplified function expression is compared with experimental data.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Energy Sustainable Development in Western Regions of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The energy sustainable development levels of Western Regions are significant to country's energy security and social economy's sustainable development. Using the factor analyze method to assess the energy sustainable development level of 2007, the results shown that the energy sustainable development level existence huge difference in Western Regions, the energy efficiency and the environmental impact are the primary factors decides the energy sustainable development level, the energy sustainable development level is inconsistent with the economic development level, so, enhancement various areas energy efficiency, reducing the environmental pollution by energy use, strength the adjustment of industry restructure and the foreign exchange, established the new energy is the probably way to improve energy sustainable development of Western Regions.

articleTitle: Experiment and Mechanism Study on Shell Powder as Briquette Sulfur-Fixed Agent
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Shell powder was used as coal briquette sulfur-fixed agent. Orthogonal testing method was used to study the main factors which have influences on the desulphurization ration. Its desulphurization ration is 56.6% at 1150°C, and it increased above 40% than CaCO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>. The main component of shell powder is CaCO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>. It also has high alkali metal such as Na and K, and other elements of iron, aluminum and silicon. The cinder which generated at 1150°C by coal was studied by XRD, and the mechanism that the shell powder has high desulphurization ration under high temperature is discussed. CaAlSi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sub> which is composite crystal is found in cinder. CaSO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> is covered by it at high temperature, then the decomposition of CaSO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> is suppressed. And the desulphurization ration is improved.

articleTitle: Extraction of Gold from Alkaline Gold Leaching Solution by Tertiary Amine N235 and Phosphine Oxide
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Extraction of gold from alkaline gold leaching solution by N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">235</sub>-TRPO synergistic system was studied. The effects of the concentrations of Tri-akylphosphine oxide(TRPO)and tertiary amine(N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">235</sub>), the initial pH, and the concentration of gold on the extraction of gold and the extraction isotherm were inspected. The ability of extracting other metal elements by this system had been investigated. The effect of alkali concentration on stripping of gold from loaded organic phase had also been studied. The experimental results indicate that the system consisting of 10% N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">235</sub>, 10% TRPO gave high extraction yield for gold along with the lesser extraction of silver and copper which are needed to recover. The gold extraction was over 94%, at pH=9~10 and the stripping of gold from loaded organic phase using 0.05mol/L NaOH can reach 91.43%.

articleTitle: How to Reduce the Rebound Effect in the Household Sector of China for the National Energy Demand and Energy Security
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: As technologies advance constantly, households respond to energy efficiency improvement with higher energy consumption per unit. The current rapid economic development and the other latent reason - rebound effect induce such phenomenon. Rebound effect has long been ignored in the household energy efficiency of China while it has been recognized widely all over the world. Since there exists a high rebound effect of at least 30% in the household energy efficiency of China and has a negative influence on the energy demand and security, this article summarizes five feasible ways reduce the rebound effect and analyzes the values:(1) increase energy prices, (2) build rational energy prices system, (3) improve consumer behavior, (4) improve energy efficiency, and (5) develop renewable energy resources.

articleTitle: Platinum Nano-particles Supported by Surface-Functionalized Multi-wall Carbon Nanotubes to Be Used as PEMFC Catalyst
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Surface nitrile group functionalized multi-walled carbon nanotubes supported Pt nanocomposites were prepared by the reduction of hexachloroplatinate acid in glycol solution suspended surface functionalized multi-walled carbon nanotubes. Average particle sizes of Pt nanoparticles were estimated by XRD method and TEM micrographs. The data show narrow distribution of the particle size of the Pt nanoparticles deposited on the surface of multi-walled carbon nanotubes. Surface functionalized multi-walled carbon nanotubes were not only as support for Pt nanoparticles anchored to but also as stabilizer for the deposition of Pt nanoparticles dispersion, and affected the particle size and electro catalysis ability of the nanoparticles.

articleTitle: A Mass-Load Based Source Shift Algorithm to Simplify Water-Using Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: When a preliminary water-using network is obtained with a synthesis approach, the network can be further simplified to reduce the interconnection number by shifting the source streams. In this paper, a mass-load based source shift algorithm is proposed to simplify water-using networks. A few examples are investigated to show the method proposed. The approach proposed in this work is simpler than the literature methods. From the results obtained, it can be seen that the method proposed can provide networks which cannot be obtained by the literature methods.

articleTitle: Improved Dual Coding Genetic Algorithm for the Optimal Design of Looped Pipe Network Based on Cycle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: An optimization model for looped pipe network is established, in which the least investment is taken as objective function, and the improved genetic algorithm is used to solve the problem. Based on the characteristics of looped pipe network optimization, the dual coding genetic algorithm combining binary coding with integer coding is adopted to optimize the pipe network layout and pipe diameter simultaneously, and the restriction of pipe diameter is satisfied automatically. Aiming at the binary coding, in the operations of initial solutions creating, crossing and mutation, cycle-based method is adopted, the infeasible solutions are avoided or the probability of producing infeasible solutions is reduced, and the fitness function is improved, so the optimum performance of the algorithm is improved. In the example the investment cost is reduced 11.65%, and it shows that the algorithm is efficient.

articleTitle: Research of Removing HSS from Organic Amine Desulphurization Solution
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: In amine FGD process, great amount of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> rapidly cumulate in the amine desulfurization solution. This paper compares the three types of desalination method, respectively Chemical precipitation, ion exchange method and Cooling crystallization, the experiment results show that: Chemical precipitation method can remove 68.51% SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup>, while 97.46% SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> is separated, Cooling crystallization method, SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> removal rate can reach 86.45% at 7°C when the molar of Na<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> and SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> ratio is 1.61. Ion exchange method can not effectively remove SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> from high concentration solution, but considerable Cl<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> and NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> is adsorbed by the resin, Cooling crystallization combined with ion exchange resins method can effectively remove SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup>, Cl<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>, NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> and other HSS, Obviously better than single ion exchange method.

articleTitle: Excess Sludge Disintegration by Combined Effects of Ultrasonic and Mechanical Treatment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Excess Sludge was disintegrated by combined effects of ultrasonic and mechanical treatment. Investigation experiments were carried out to disintegrate excess sludge by combined both treatment methods. As results, the optimal disintegration effect was obtained by 6min ultrasonic treatment combined with 7min mechanical treatment, and DDCOD was 43.48%, SCOD/E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">S</sub> was 0.52. Under the same energy consumption condition (E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">S</sub> was 7053.3 kJ/kg·TS and 7038.0 kJ/kg·TS, relatively), disintegration rate DDCOD of combined treatment method was increased by 16.70% when compared with that of either of the methods. So, it was concluded that higher efficient disintegration effect could be obtained by combined effects of ultrasonic and mechanical treatment.

articleTitle: Research on Total-Factor Energy Efficiency in Guizhou Industrial Sectors
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Based on non-parametric data envelopment analysis (DEA) and the framework of total factor, this paper empirically measures the total-factor energy efficiency of the 25 industrial sectors in Guizhou Province with statistical data through 2005-2007. The results show that the index of total-factor energy efficiency (EE) is found fitting better to the real case than the indicators of single-factor energy intensity, the overall energy efficiency of Guizhou industrial sectors is still very low, the average energy efficiency of sectors is affected by the large proportion of low energy efficiency sectors in industry, The comprehensive technological efficiency(TE) and energy efficiency (EE) are low in most sectors, we should enhance the technological level of sectors and optimize the industry structure and resource allocation. The energy rigid demand of some high energy intensity sectors lead to the relative excess of energy input.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Coal Bed Methane Resource Based on Mapgis in Hancheng Mining Area
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The spatial database of coal bed methane (CBM) is established on the analysis of data about CBM in Hancheng mining area. the relationship between the content of methane and main structure line, the radius of buffer area for structure control of gas is confirmed, the storing layer is divided into three parts: seepage district, and blocked and vaporized district by the buffer analysis of the area. With the spliced analysis of coal thickness, content of methane, coal depth, coal construction and close function of roof and floor structure condition, the CBM exploitation of main coal seam is divided into advantageous, disadvantageous and common area. Finally it points out the target area of exploitation.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Atmospheric Circulation and Water Vapor Conditions of Precipitation over the Heihe River Basin
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: It is of great significance to understanding deeply mechanism of precipitation and estimating accurately amount of precipitation. The purpose of this work is to explore the atmosphere effects on the precipitation over the Heihe river basin. Based on NCEP/NCAR re-analysis dataset with the resolution of 1° × 1° and 25° × 2.5° over the period 2000-2006 and monthly precipitation from 15 stations for the same period, we investigated the vertical circulation and vapor conditions for the local-scale and further explore large-scale atmospheric circulation patterns for the rainy years and less rainy years. The comparative analysis results show that for both kinds of years, the water vapor all are net inflow averaged from June to September. However, there are notable differences in western and south boundary. In the western boundary, the inflow of vapor for the rainy years is more than that for the less rainy years. In the south boundary, there is a net inflow of vapor in the rainy years. Whereas there is a net outflow in the less rainy years. Besides, one more important point is that local ascending motion which is predominantly meridional over the Heihe river basin. Its range, position, and intensity have remarkable differences in the rainy years and less rainy years. The maximum vertical velocity is 1.2 cm/s for the former, and that for the latter is only 0.8 cm/s with the difference of 0.4 cm/s. This phenomenon is discovered for the first time in this region. Furthermore, more/less precipitation corresponds well with the higher/lower Qinghai-Tibet plateau temperature, stronger/weaker 100hPa high-pressure of the Qinghai-Tibet plateau, and stronger/weaker westerly jet. The interaction of these systems aforementioned can make more precipitation mainly due to more water vapor inflow and stronger converging-ascending motion for the rainy years. The opposite is the case for the less rainy years.

articleTitle: A Novel Fibrous Zirconium Sulfate Solid Acid Catalyst for Esterification Reaction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The new type of catalytic zirconium sulfate solid acid material was prepared by using collagen fiber as matrices. The catalyst structure remains fibrous confirmed by SEM. Activities of catalyst etherification of acetic acid with n-butanol were evaluated. Optimal esterification conditions are found out. The catalyst was high in catalytic activity for the synthesis of n-butyl acetate, it overcame the drawbacks of liquid acid and it had convenient separation with liquid phase after reaction without corroding equipment, it was easy in recycle, non - polluting. So the catalyst is a promising application.

articleTitle: The Flocculation Condition of Rare Earth Polymerization Coagulants
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Using hydrochloric acid solution and rare earth concentrate mixed heating method, which is prepared a new polymer flocculant polymerization of rare earth coagulants (PRE), studied the amount of coagulant, pH value, slowly stir intensity, slowly stir time, sediment time on polymerization of rare earth coagulants coagulation effect. And will fuse rare earth coagulants (PRE) with common coagulants IC simplifies PFC and PAC conducted comparative experiments. By dealing with the yellow studies showed that the polymerization of rare earth coagulants optimum flocculation conditions for pH value for 5 ~ 9, Slowly stir intensity 70r/min, Slowly stir time 10 min, Settling time 10 min, Polymerization of rare earth of coagulant coagulation effect is better than that of IC simplifies PFC and PAC, Has formed body structure is close-grained, settlement flocculant good performance, less, to generate sludge volume turbidity removal efficiency high characteristic.

articleTitle: Effects of DOM on Cr6+ Mobility in Saturated Soil-Water Systems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: This study investigated the effects of dissolved organic matter (DOM) extracted form maize straw on the mobility of Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6+</sup> in sandy soil and losses widespread in northwest region through simulated dynamic soil column system. The results indicated that the mobility of Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6+</sup> was influenced significantly by DOM in saturated water-soil system. Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6+</sup> had strong mobility because of weak adsorption and easily to be desorption both in the loess and sand without DOM, and especially in the sandy soil. DOM presence promoted Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6+</sup> adsorption in the loess and sand, both the breakthrough time and adsorption capacity to Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6+</sup> increased, consequently the mobility of Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6+</sup> decreased dramatically. Moreover, when DOM and Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6+</sup> were coexistence in the system, both the mobility of them had been weakened. Particle size of loess also effected adsorption of DOM and Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6+</sup>. Experimental results showed that the adsorption of 60 mesh loess(0.3mm)>;untreated loess>;20 mesh loess (0.9mm). Therefore, it is concluded that the existence of DOM are the main factors that determine the effectiveness of Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6+</sup> mobility for decreasing the amounts of soil available Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6+</sup> in Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6+</sup>-contaminated soils. It is very meaningful to prevent and control of ground water pollution.

articleTitle: Algorithm of Digital Phase-Sensitive Short-Circuit Protection Based on dq Coordinate Transformation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: In coal mines, phase-sensitive short-circuit protection is one of most common methods to protect power supply line by distinguishing between short-circuit current and starting current, but it is difficult to avoid false operation by hardware technology to catch power factor angle on the influence of in-situ environment and device characteristics. In this paper, a new method is proposed to calculate power factor angle by dq coordinate transformation, which can successfully detect the zero-crossing of voltage and current, and avoid the false operation of phase-sensitive short-circuit protection.

articleTitle: Effects of Water-Lime Ratio and Stirring Speed of Lime Dry Hydration on Hydration Productions Properties
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: In this paper, the effects of two main factors on dry hydration productions properties of water-lime ratio and stirring speed were studied by using a pint-sized dry hydration equipment. The effect of water-lime ratio and stirring speed on hydration rate were analyzed. Characteristic of temperature rise during hydration procedure was put forward, and the surface structure characteristics and size distribution under different hydration conditions were obtained by using SEM and particle size analyzer. The results show that with the increase of water-lime ratio, the lime hydration rate increased, but the temperature of the lime slaker decreased, which result in the particle diameter distribution moving towards the large range of particle, and the mean diameter increasing gradually. SEM images appear the presence of agglomeration at higher water-lime ratio. With the increase of stirring speed, the hydration rate decreased, but particle diameter distribution moved towards the small rang of particle.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbon Formation in n-Heptane HCCI Combustion
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: By modifying the SENKIN code of CHEMKIN chemical kinetics package, the combustion processes and the characteristics of hydrocarbon (HC) and carbon monoxide(CO) emissions of a HCCI engine were simulated. Furthermore, the formation of benzene (A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>) and polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons including naphthalene (A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>), phenanthrene (A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>), and pyrene (A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>) in n-heptane HCCI combustion were analyzed. A multi-zone computational model was built and a detailed chemical kinetics mechanism that consists of 107 species and 542 reactions was adopted. The results show that the multi-zone model and the reaction mechanism adopting in this paper are basically correct through the comparison of the cylinder pressure between experimental data from the literature and the results by this model. It is shown that the crevice zone is the main source of the HC emission, while the CO emission is mainly from the boundary layer. Among these four aromatic and polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, the emission of A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> is the highest, A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is following, and the emission of A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> is almost zero.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation on the Performance of the Steam Ejector
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: In this paper, Fluent 6.2 is employed to investigate the flow structure of the steam ejector used in the steam jet refrigeration system. Effect of the operating pressure on the entrainment ratio of the ejector is discussed. For a given ejector, there exists an optimum primary fluid pressure at which maximum entrainment ratio is obtained. Entrainment ratio is increased by increasing the secondary fluid pressure and decreasing the discharge pressure.

articleTitle: Study on the Optimum Preparation Process Conditions of Iron Oxide Coated Sand
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The Iron Oxide Coated Sands (IOCS) are prepared with ordinary quartz sands and the modifier- FeCl3. By using the orthogonal test method, morphological properties analysis and semi-quantitative analysis method by EDS, effects of different factors on surface loading and adherent strength on the surface of IOCS are analyzed: stirring frequency N, dosage ratio of FeCl3 to NaOH, calcination temperature T and time t, appearance of IOCS and etc. The optimum preparation conditions of IOCS are investigated. Results are obtained: (1)Stirring had better not be taken when drying IOCS at 110°C before calcination, (2) At high temperature, calcining conditions should be controlled: t ≥ 3 h and T ≈ 300°C; (3) The optimal dosing ratio of FeCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> (2mol/L) to Raw Quartz Sand(RQS) is 0.33 mL FeCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>/g RQS. The surface loading of iron oxide is up to the maximum with dosing ratio of NaOH to RQSis 0.3 mL NaOH/g RQS. However, if dosing ratio is too high, the surface loading will decrease markedly, and the adherent strength will be weak. (4) As compared with IOCS-0 prepared by the alkaline deposition method at low temperature(T ≤ 110°C), IOCS-1 which is prepared by calcining IOCS-0 at high temperature (T ≈ 300°C), whose surface loading will be increased by 3~5 times, and desorption rate will decrease by more than 90%. (5) The content of α-FeOOH (Goethite) on surface loading of IOCS affects adherent strength strongly. The particle size of α-Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> (Hematite) attached on the surface of IOCS-1 can be changed by controlling the calcining temperature. The prepared IOCS-1 can efficiently adsorb pollutants in the same size as that of IOCS-1 particles.

articleTitle: Flow Field Analysis and Optimum Design of Jet-Mixing Apparatus Based on CFD
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Aimed at providing theoretical foundation for designing optimal jet-mixing apparatus, computational fluid dynamics (CFD)modeling for jet-mixing apparatus was established and numerical investigation for it's interior flow field was performed with CFD code FLUENT. Simulated data was validated by actual experimental data, then the validated model was employed to investigate the three main parameters of jet-mixing apparatus :nozzle exit position S, area ratio m and angle between suction pipe and jet-mixing appratus axis γ on its performance. under different working conditions, with the the rule of single parameter to the effect of jet-mixing apparatus was obtained.

articleTitle: Evolution Analysis of Wind Power Industry in China Based on Logistic Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Based on Logistic model and learning curve, using empirical formula of energy exploitation and regression statistics tool, this paper mainly simulated the development process of wind power industry in China through establishing evolution model of wind-power industry. It is found that China's wind-power industry has greater potential and sustainability in its development. What's more, installed capacity and the manufacturing capability on wind-power equipments are improving quickly. At the same time, the super-high increase speed of China's wind power industry in recent years is an indication of overheated characteristics, which needs our more attention.

articleTitle: Exploitation and Utilization Strategy of Coal Resources in Hebei Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Hebei province is the main one of energy production and energy consumption, the steady and plenteous supply of coal is the foundation of regional economic sustainable development. The coal resources and other energy resources in Hebei province are relative shortage which has resulted in a serious energy security issues. This paper analyzed the problems and challenges of coal exploitation and utilization in Hebei province, especially the lack of effective supply capacity coal resources, mining reserve shortage, unreasonable industrial structure and low energy efficiency. Based on the above, the policies and recommendations of coal development strategy are proposed, and it is emphasized that the key tasks are strengthening coal geological exploration, optimizing the energy structure and industrial structure to reduce unit energy consumption in Hebei province.

articleTitle: PDMDAAC United Inorganic Flocculants for Treating Surface Water and Fractal Dimensions of Flocs
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Poly diallyl dimethyl ammonium chloride (PDMDAAC) is a cationic organic polymer flocculant, The aim of this work is to use PFS or PAC for treating surface raw water and PDMDAAC as coagulant aid. Electron microscope was used to observe flocs morphology and study PDMDAAC coagulation aid morphological change, floc image with microscope camera system analysis, calculation of floc fractal dimension. The results show that the, PDMDAAC in dealing with the surface raw water to play a good coagulation aid effect. Microscope and image analysis system of flocs morphology show that fractal dimension of morphology of PFS and PFS/PDMDAAC were 1.521, 1.544, and fractal dimension of morphology of PAC and PAC/PDMDAAC were 1.303, 1.395, respectively. Floc fractal dimension changes to better reflect the flocculation level and treatment effect for the establishment of floc fractal dimension number of changes in the coagulation control is provided for reference.

articleTitle: Research on Heat Storage Characteristics of a Triple-Sleeve Energy Storage Exchanger
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Using phase change material of phase-change temperature 6°C, triple-sleeve energy storage exchanger is proposed. The exchanger, air source and solar heat pump compose an integrated system. Established mathematical model of the triple-sleeve energy storage exchanger according to enthalpy method and simulating heat storage dynamic characteristics of triple-sleeve energy storage exchanger, analyzing the impact of the thickness of the phase change, fluid flow, and fluid inlet temperature. It lays a theoretical foundation for energy storage devices and integrated systems development and optimization design.

articleTitle: Kinetics of Organic and Ammonia Removal in Swine Wastewater Treatment Using Moving Bed Biofilm Reactor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: A pilot-scale experiment with a treating3capacity of 10 m per day was carried out for swine wastewater treatment by using of a moving bed biofilmreactor (MBBR). The reactor was start-up in 60 days period and run for a year, and an average removal rate of 82.9%for COD and 89.0% for ammonia were achieved, under a hydraulic retention time (HRT) of 12h, with influent COD and ammonia of 1686 ¡À 497 mg/L and 582 ¡À 126 mg/L, respectively. The effluent met the national discharge standard of pollutants for livestock and poultry breeding(GB 18596-2001) of China. The kinetics of organic carbon and ammonia removals in the MBBR was studied based on the Stover-Kin cannon model and the 1/2 order substrate removal model, respectively. Temperature coefficient "¦È"was introduced into the COD and ammonia removal models to describe the effects of the temperature. The model simulated results showed good agreements with experimental results. The model could be employed for the design of a full-scale MBBR process for simultaneous removal of organic carbon and ammonia from swine wastewaters.

articleTitle: Exergy Analysis for LNG Refrigeration Cycle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The compression process of LNG accounts for a large part of the total energy which the huge LNG liquefaction ship consumes, and the account is increasing constantly, with the continuous development and application of natural gas. In order to improve energy efficiency, the exergy analysis is done to the refrigeration cycle which the LNG ship adopts. A conclusion is drawn after the exergy analysis to the refrigeration cycle, that the exergy efficiency of the gas booster compressor is the least, the heat-exchange equipment the biggest, and throttle valve between them. Through aggregate analysis of exergy efficiency of three parts, a proposal can be drawn to optimizing the application of the LNG liquefaction ship, that to improve the performance of the compressor coefficient and to improve the circulation structure, can significantly improve the system exergy efficiency, which provides a reliable basis for reconstructing energy-saving technological.

articleTitle: Research Progress in Heat and Mass Transfer Enhancement of the Ammonia Falling Film Absorption
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The studies in recent years about performance reinforcement in the ammonia falling film absorption are introduced in this paper. The enhancement methods and absorption performance influencing factors are summarized and analyzed. Some deficiencies in this research field are pointed out and future research directions are also discussed. It is pointed out that a combination way of physical treatment, chemical treatment and application of nanotechnology is probably the trend of strengthening the absorption performance in the future.

articleTitle: Role of Fe(III) in Microbial Activity and Extracellular Polymeric Substances
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Over the past few decades, most of research has been conducted on the extraction method, composition and cell surface characteristics connected with EPS. It was recently proposed that activated sludge floes are comprised of different types of EPS with distinct metal ion binding characteristics. Fe (III) was a common wastewater composition, in practice, which may promote the biofilm activity and amount distinctly. But few detailed research was conducted on the correlation Fe (III) with the composition and microbiology activity with EPS. Experimental results indicated that the variation of Fe (III) concentration in influent produced biofilm with different abundances of EPS and different composing and microbial activity characteristics. The biofilm that was fed on large amount of Fe (III) had more EPS than the biofilm that was fed on little amount of Fe (III). The contents of polysaccharide and protein improved considerably as Fe (III) participated in. The results demonstrate that the Fe (III) had a positive effect on EPS and activity of biofilm. The performance of biological degradation was much more closely correlated with the amount of protein than with the amount of polysaccharide.

articleTitle: A novel thermodynamic performance evaluation method for trigeneration system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: To get reasonable and reliable index of performance of combined cooling, heating and power (CCHP) system, a new performance evaluation method of the system, the comprehensive efficiency, is proposed. The method is based on energy, exergy and energy analyses. An example is given to illustrate application of the new method in this study. The analysis results show that the comprehensive efficiency is generally found to be more meaningful and indicative of system behaviour than the energy efficiency and exergy efficiency respectively. It reveals not only the energy grade difference amount energy products of CCHP system, but also quantizes the energy's contribution to cooling and heating by equivalent available coefficient of anergy. It is anticipated that the results will provide a convenient and practical tool for engineers and researchers dealing with the analysis, design, operation, optimization and improvement of trigeneration systems.

articleTitle: Community Diversity of Nitrosobacteria in SBR Denitrified System for Treating the Livestock Wastewater
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Short-cut nitrification and denitrification had achieved in this Sequencing Batch Reactor (SBR). At the aerating stage, nitrosobacteria had survived much better than nitrobacteria and the concentration ratio of [NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>-N]/[NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>-N] was exceed 50% .After one cycle running, the total ammonia was removed completely. We wished to discover if we could gain greater insights into the relationship between the community construction of nitrosobacteria and the accumulation of nitrite nitrogen in this reactor. This examination used the molecular biology technology by amplifying the target fragment of amoA gene from total DNA of activated sludge, by coupling the target gene with pGM-T vector and transforming them into E.coli DH5a competent cells. Randomly, picked some white clones out from the LB solid nutritive medium, and used RFLP markers to obtain the restriction patterns. RFLP analysis showed that there were 8 kinds of restriction patterns among these clones. After comparing homologies with standard strains, the results confirmed that there were 3 genera of nitrosobacteria in this reactor: Nitrosospira sp., Nitrosomomas sp. and Nitrosococcus sp., the distributing frequencies were 0.285, 0.392 and 0.035, respectively. Preliminary analysis, Nitrosolobus multiformis and Nitrosomomas europaea had played the predominant role in accumulating nitrite nitrogen.

articleTitle: An Experimental Study on Thermal Energy Storage Based Reverse Cycle Defrosting Method Using Sub-cooling Energy of Refrigerant for Air Source Heat Pump: Characteristics of Thermal Energy Storage Operation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: the introduction of the system of thermal energy storage (TES) based reverse cycle defrosting method using sub-cooling energy of refrigerant for air Source heat pump(ASHP) is given firstly. And then the characteristic of TES using sub-cooling energy of refrigerant in heating is experimentally researched. The results show that storing sub-cooling energy of refrigerant in the PCM can not only improve the system COP in heating, but also provide energy for defrosting. Two modes of TES are inferred and it proves that improved system performances and indoor thermal comfort can be resulted in mode of starting TES process when heating for one hour.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on a New-Type Thermoelectric Heat Pump Phase Change Thermal Energy Storage Device
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: This paper integrated the technology of thermoelectric heat pump and phase-change thermal storage, developed an active phase-change thermal storage/release device, which can retrieve and utilize low-quality energy(cryogenic energy), and made experimental study on it. The experimental results show that: the device has obvious phase-change process and striking thermal storage effect. When storing heat, the highest heating coefficient of THP can come up to 2.2, when THP was used to supply heat for the part, the highest heating coefficient can come up to 5.6. The device overcame the uncontrollability of the heat transfer intensity and time, which usually occurred in the process of traditional passive heat storage/release, and greatly improved the efficiency of retrieving and utilizing low-temperature exhaust heat.

articleTitle: Can CO2 Regeneration Heat Consumption Be Reduced by Using the Novel “Mass Concentration of Solvent Swing Regeneration (MCSR)” Technology?
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: To reduce CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> regeneration heat consumption in CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> capture process, a novel concept named "mass concentration of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-rich solution swing regeneration (MSCR)" was put forward in this study. Experiments were executed to investigate the feasibility and energy reduction potential of MSCR by using MEA as absorbent. Results show that CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> regeneration performance can be improved greatly when MSCR was adopted. In addition, relatively high but appropriate mass concentration should be recommended to be selected for the initial CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> rich solution. And experimental results also prove that MCSR technology may be more viable for the bicarbonate-producing systems between the reaction of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and absorbent or for carbamate-producing systems with high CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> loading. Finally, evaluation of total regeneration heat consumption shows that the total CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> regeneration heat consumption can be reduced by at least about 25% for MSCR.

articleTitle: Full Load Calculation of Large-Scale Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: In order to ensure large-scale wind turbine in normal operation within its design life, it is necessary to analyze the each main component's fatigue of wind turbine in the design process. A prerequisite is to get the exact load situation fast and accurately. This paper studied the load of wind turbine, derived the formula used to calculate the load, writed a computer program and obtained the load data provided for the fatigue analysis.

articleTitle: The Characteristics of Lakes of Water Source Heat Pump Systems in Chongqing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Water quality and temperature have important influences on energy efficiency of Lakes Water Source Heat Pump (LWSHP) systems. The characteristics of lake, especial spatial and temporal distribution features, must be obtained in order to take high quality water. By one year' s monitoring for quality and temperature of Caiyun lake in Chongqing, the results show that average monthly temperature was 26~30°C in summer, 11~15°C in winter. Caiyun Lake water has obvious vertical stratification in summer, while no such phenomenon was found in winter. pH value, turbidity and chlorophyll a also have obvious characteristics in vertical distribution, while hardness and salinity have little characteristics. Lakes water in Chongqing is a hot and cold water source of Water Source Heat Pump (WSHP) of high quality. Water intake head should be installed in the middle and lower layer of the lake, the main problem of water quality is to remove algae and scale inhibition.

articleTitle: Improvement of Energy Efficiency for Combined Heat and Power System via Kuhn-Tucker Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: This paper presents a novel design procedure for optimizing power distribution strategy in combined heat and power system. The optimal control problem was formulated as a nonlinear optimization problem subject to set of constraints. The resulting problem was solved using the Kuhn-Tucker method. Computer simulation results demonstrated that the proposed method provided better efficient in terms of reducing total costs compared to the existing methods. In addition, the proposed optimal load distribution strategy can be easily implemented in real-time thanks to the simplicity of the closed-form solutions.

articleTitle: Issue and Improvement Measure of Multi-split Air Conditioner
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Existing problems of traditional air source variable refrigerant flow (VRF) air-conditioning system are analyzed. The disadvantages of traditional VRF air-conditioning system are described in detail: 1) its properties are seriously affected by outdoor temperature. 2) The system has lower cooling capacity and coefficient of performance with an expansion of the scale. 3) It is not convenient to install outdoor units for many actual projects. Based on the analysis of these disadvantages, water loop variable refrigerant flow (WLVRF)integrated air-conditioning system is introduced. Its schematic and characteristics are narrated. The running conditions and coefficient of WLVRF system in Shenyang, Beijing and Jinan are simulated taking a high-rise office building as a sample. The result shows that WLVRF system satisfies high-rise building in cold climate well, and it can operate securely and efficiently.

articleTitle: Study on Preparation Condition Optimization and Kinetics for Biodemulsifier
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Using strain JM-1 producing biodemulsifier isolated from cold rolling plant emulsion wastewater as the starting strain, the optimum preparation conditions of the biodemulsifier were obtained by the experiment of carbon source, nitrogen source, trace element, and ratio of carbon to nitrogen. The concentration of the lipopeptide reached 1.62 g/L, which was 22.73% higher than un-optimized. The biodemulsifier preparation kinetics were investigated. The kinetic models of strains growth and lipopeptide formation were established by Matlab, providing a good description of temporal variations of biomass, and product in JM-1 fermentation. These models were applied to guide the industrial production of the biodemulsifier.

articleTitle: Practice and Development of Municipal Solid Waste Rapid Composting in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: After the development of municipal solid waste (MSW) composting domestic and abroad was reviewed systematically, the developing restricted factors and applied difficulties of composting technologies recently in our country were discussed comprehensively. The developing trend of composting research is to meet the need of rapid fermentation of MSW which has high water and organic material content. At last, the technical points and feasibilities of a new-type rapid composting process was demonstrated based on the energy-saving effect of gravity tipping rapid composting of MSW with a short period.

articleTitle: Synthesis and Identification of Artificial Antigens for an Antibody of Anthracene
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: To detect the residue of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) in the environment quickly by immune method, preparation of high quality antibody against PAHs is the most critical step of the project As the first step toward developing sensitive enzyme linked immunosorbent assays (ELISAs) for selective detection of anthracene in environment, a new hapten was synthesized by the Friedel-Crafts acylation reaction from anthracene. It bears a carboxylic group with four carbon length spacer at the position 1 of anthracene. The hapten was characterized by <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>H NMR, IR, and element analysis. The hapten was coupled with bovine serum albumin (BSA) to raise an antibody or with ovalbumin (OVA) to form competitor conjugate. The artificial antigents were verified by their spectral characteristics using ultraviolet spectrophotometry. The resultant immunogen was fabricated and used to stimulate immune responses in rabbits to survey the characteristics of the hapten. The obtained antiserum exhibited relatively high antibody titer (1:110000) in indirect ELISA.

articleTitle: Preparation of Lithium Iron Phosphate from High-Iron-Containing Desulphurization Slag
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Using high-iron-containing desulphurization slag as raw materials, ferrous sulfates with the high purity of 99.0% were prepared by microwave-assisted acid leaching. Ferrous oxalates were prepared from the ferrous sulfate. The effects of dose and reaction temperature were investigated to get ultra-fine ferrous oxalate. Lithium iron phosphates were then synthesized by using mechanical-chemical method with above lab-made ferrous oxalate. The experimental results showed that when the burning temperature of 700°C and reaction time of 4h were used, it was feasible to produce spherical lithium iron phosphate particles with high purity, good crystallinity and evenly distributed particle size (the average diameter of 9.407μm).

articleTitle: 300MW CFB Direct Air Cooled System Frostproof Control Strategy Optimization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: First proposed the Shanxi Coal Power Plant Phase Il Pingshuo 2X300MW CFB direct air cooled system winter frostproof protection of frost question, introduced its direct air cooled system of the power plant control system, elaborated the automatically controlled scheme of frostproof in the direct air cooled system, analyzing the existing existence question and earring on to optimization the existing programs, meanwhile, the engineering operation for further elaboration and analysis, optimized the direct air cooled system's frostproof protection control scheme.

articleTitle: Research on IDSS and Reasoning Algorithm of Coal Mine Extraction-Tunneling Plans
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: By analyzing the manual establishment process of the coal mine extraction-tunneling plans, the experiences and knowledge are obtained, and the knowledge sets of the coal mine extraction-tunneling plans are formed, then the technical and economic models are built. Combining the decision support system with the expert system, the advantages of quantitative calculation of the decision support system and qualitative analysis of the expert system can be embodied wonderfully. Using this idea, the auto compiling system of the coal mine extraction-tunneling plans is founded and the reasoning algorithm is put forward. The system can compile the coal mine extraction-tunneling plans quickly and can bring huge economic and social benefits.

articleTitle: Sediment and Water Quality Response to Climate Change in Bai River Basin
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Geographic informational system (GIS) and the Soil and Water Assessment Tool (SWAT) was used to simulate the transport of runoff, sediment, total nitrogen and total phosphorus into the Zhangjiafen stations. The main objective was to discuss climate change affecting on sediment and water quality. The results showed: The SWAT generally performs well and could accurately simulate monthly runoff, sediment, total nitrogen and total phosphorus yield with a Nash-Sutcliffe coefficient and a coefficient of determination of greater than 0.7 during calibration and validation. Climate change had large effect on runoff, followed by sediment, total nitrogen and total phosphorus.

articleTitle: Landscape Planning of the Green Network in Tai Po Industrial Estate in Hong Kong
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Green network is a strategic tool in urban planning to increase the energy efficient of urban green spaces. It is especially useful to solve the problems caused by the extremely limited green cover in the compact cities like Hong Kong. Stepping stones, green corridors and green patches are strategies in forming the green network. In this study, using Tai Po Industrial Estate in Hong Kong as a case study, principles and the establishment procedure of green network were analyzed from the perspective of landscape ecology. Based on the field investigations, the optimal layout of green network inside and outside a factory was deduced. Then the planning process was conducted. Results indicate that after the planning, the structural and functional connectivity of green spaces are increased. The ecological functions of green spaces are also enhanced. The planning strategies of the green network provide significant recommendations for those in other cities and industrial estates in developed areas. The study also contributes to the research literature and planning process integrating the theory of landscape ecology with urban planning, UGS design and landscape architecture.

articleTitle: Thermal Analysis and Exergy Analysis of Evaporation Process in Alumina Refinery
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: To reduce the energy consumption of evaporation process in alumina refinery, thermal and exergy analysis were applied to the four-effect evaporators and three-stage flashes evaporation system. Result indicates that the thermal efficiency of the evaporation system is only 15.22%. The thermal efficiencies of all links are high except that of the evaporator of effect IV, which is only 6.91%. The heat losses in the evaporators of effect IV, III and I are large, which are mainly in the form of condensed water and exhausted vapor output. The exergy efficiency of the evaporation system is only 19.33%and those of the four-effect evaporators are relative low. The exergy destruction ratios of the evaporators of effect IV, III and I are 37.42%, 34.64% and 19.41%, respectively, which are the key links for the improvement of the exergy efficiency of the evaporation system. The total intrinsic exergy destruction is slightly larger than the total extrinsic one. Thus recovery and utilization of waste heat and of condensed water and exhausted vapor should be enhanced, the operating parameters in evaporators and the way of using preheaters should be optimized or improved.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Study on the Components of Cotton Stalk Wood Vinegar by TG-FTIR
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Wood vinegar is a product of agriculture and forestry residues pyrolysis with insecticidal, antibacterial effect, and is even found to have health care. In recent years, wood vinegar is being taken seriously more and more by people. Cotton stalk wood vinegar is derived from cotton stalk pyrolysis. It is the gases generated from the pyrolysis of cottons talk, changing into liquid products through condensation, its compositions are complex, mainly are acid, phenol, ketone, alcohol and other substances. This paper studied initially the way of the compositions formation about cotton wood vinegar, drawing the following conclusions: The initial phrase of cotton stalk pyrolysis mainly occurred the precipitation of free water and a small amount of organic acid, In the pre-carbonization phrase, a small amount of volatile gases composed by small molecules were released, The main pyrolysis phrase, corresponding to the maximum infrared absorption spectrum, was the main phrase during which the composition of wood vinegar were produced, At last, some phenols we reproduced in charring phrase. During the prolysis of cotton stalk, some organics generated continued to the charring stage like phenols.

articleTitle: The Influence of Straw Shape on the Formation of Deposits during Straw Briquette Combustion
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: During the combustion of straw, the formation of deposition, which destines to furnace erosion and exerts great influence on safety operation, on heating surface is affected by many factors. This paper studies influences of straw shape on the formation of deposits. Results are as follows: The shape change of fuel affects the process of fuel combustion, accordingly, it affects the formation law and properties of deposits: first, The change rule of deposition rate is different from the combustion of native straw, second, the deposition rate and amount are significantly lower than that produced by the native straw, at last, the shape of fuel has an important influence on the characteristics and composition of deposits: in fifteen minutes, the deposits are made up of black carbon, gray-black, feel smooth and are scattered, after an hour, the deposits are silver-gray, feel rough and are bonded together to form massive particles, whose surface was glassy and sintering phenomenon. The amount of alkali metal escaping from fuel increases with the furnace temperature rising, in addition, the shape of fuel is also conducive to form low melting point eutectic of alkali metal and SiO2.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Using Different Flow Pattern Bio-trickling Filter Treating Hydrogen Sulfide
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S (hydrogen sulfide) was regarded as the research object in this study. The removal performance of two bio-trickling filters was compared. One is the counter flow one, a traditional bio-trickling filter, and the other is a newly self designed cross flow bio-trickling filter. A mixed culture of activated sludge was used as bacterial seed and the bio-film was developed by culturing the bacterial in on oxygen bottle using Na<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S as inducing substrate. The cross flow bio-trickling filter can operated at high removal efficiency once start up the experiment. The counter flow one needs 4 days to start up. Compared with the traditional vertical one, the cross flow one was robust enough to recover quickly after 7 days interruption. Moreover, designation of cross flow could lighten the packing acidification. The max elimination capacity of counter flow bio-trickling filter was 170 g H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/h. Cross flow bio-trickling filter achieved the max elimination capacity of 216 g H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/h.

articleTitle: The Large-Scale Wind Energy Conversion System Blade Load Spectrum Calculation and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Blade is the key part of the wind energy conversion system, its stress is the most complex, if designed unreasonable, it can not reach the service life we expected, even it may be fractured when it is working. That will bring serious economic losses to us. So analysis the load of the blade and change rules of blade structure have extremely vital significance. Based on 750KW wind energy conversion system working date, import it into the mathematical analysis software, analysis the blade stress and torque variation anytime and anywhere, obtain the intuitive load change spectrum. We can know the variation of load change information precisely, so as to improve the blade structure and the choice of the materials.

articleTitle: Growth Conditions and Genetic Characterization of a New Manganese Resistant Strain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Phytostabilization, the use of plants for in situ stabilization of tailings and metal contaminants, is a feasible alternative to costly remediation practices.
