Ecological adaptation of metal contamination is significantly enhanced through plants inoculated with plant growth -promoting bacterial. Rhizosphere soils of Chenopodium album Linn were collected by means of field surveys of tolerating plants which grew in Xiangtan manganese tailings. 1 light-gray manganese-resistant strain numbered XY was isolated from the rhizosphere of fresh plant through concentration gradient screening technique. The cellular form, physiological and biochemical tests were conducted, as the growth curve and effects of temperature, pH, NaCl concentration to growth of the strain tested were investigated. The results of the tests showed that 1) the strain reached logarithmic phase in 12-24h; 2) the optimum temperature range of the strain was 35°C-40°C; 3) the optimum pH range of the strain was 6.8-7.3; 4) the optimum NaCl concentration range of the strain was 5g/L. The status of the strain in the taxonomy and phylogeny has been conformed according to 16S rDNA sequences, the strainXY belongs to Arthrobacter genus.

articleTitle: Catalytic Ozonation of Mineral Processing Wastewater Containing Butyl Xanthate
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The removal of flotation reagent butyl xanthate by catalytic ozonation process using Mn-Ce-Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> as catalyst was investigated. The effects of initial pH value, ozone dosage, catalyst loading, initial solution concentration, different process on butyl xanthate removal ratio were carried out. There action mechanism of Mn-Ce-Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> for butyl xanthate was discussed by adding tert-butyl alcohol. The stability of catalyst was further researched. The results show that removal ratio of butyl xanthate can be reached 98.72% at initial pH =7.22, 1.75g/h of ozone dosage, 0.5g/l of catalyst loading, 100mg/l of initial solution concentration and 8 min of reaction time. butyl xanthate removal ratio is not significantly affected by introduction of different concentration tert-butyl alcohol. It can preliminary judge the reaction mechanism of Mn-Ce-Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>/O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> system for butyl xanthate removal is non-hydroxyl radical dominance. It is worthy to note that organic flotation reagent removal by catalytic ozonation technology is feasible and has certain developing potential.

articleTitle: Processing Parameter Optimization for Injection Moulding Products in Agricultural Equipment Based on Orthogonal Experiments and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: There are many quality-related factors in the manufacture of injection molding products of agriculture equipment. It is a trouble to find out the key factors and to optimize the process plan with these key factors. This study introduces a practice way: to design the factors test based on orthogonal experiment, and to analog test with software Moldflow MPI 6.0, then to handles the data with range and variance analysis theory, finally turn out the optimization process plan.

articleTitle: The Countermeasures for Fluvial Environmental Abnormal Variation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Unreasonable activities of mankind in water resources exploitation have deteriorated the natural environment, intensifying the conflicts between human beings and the nature. Environment and natural disasters have brought forward rigorous challenge on the survival and development of the mankind. The concept of environmental variation is proposed in analyzing the processes of environmental change, and the reparation methods for fluvial environment variation have been stated as well. Styles of fluvial environmental variation can be classified according to characteristics of river and human activities. The characteristics and the consequences of the environmental variation in the estuary of Yellow River are analyzed, so has the control method.

articleTitle: Health Risk Assessment of Heavy Metals in Shanghai Urban Parks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Heavy metals, a kind of persistent toxic substance(PTS), were taken for the study in this paper. Dust samples we recollected in Shanghai urban parks. The concentrations of mean metals in dust samples were in the order Zn >; Pb >; Cu, where Pb shows the greatest coefficient of variation. Human health risk was evaluated in Shanghai urban parks. The pathway of direct ingestion is dominating for children exposed to PTS, which is more than 98% of the overall exposure dose. Through statistical analysis of arcgis module, the corresponding distributions of Cu, Pb and Zn show an increasing trend towards inner ring road. By contrast with roadside dust samples, collected near the upper reaches of the Huang pu River, the main sources of these elements in Shanghai urban parks were mainly derived from human activities, especially for traffic sources.

articleTitle: Preparation of Ag+ Doped Nanometer TiO2 Photocatalyst with Sol-gel Auto-igniting Synthesis Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: To investigate the photocatalytic activity of metal ion doped TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> synthesized with sol-gel auto-igniting synthesis (SAS) method, Ag-TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> photocatalyst was synthesized with TiCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> as raw materials, citric acid as combustion agent, ammonium nitrate as assistant. Methylene blue was degraded with synthesized catalyst illuminated by UV light and sun light separately. Results showed that the photocatalytic activity increased when Ag loading was 1.5% (mol), which was 2.18 times of that with UV light and 1.14 times of that with sun light as light source separately. However, excessive loading of Ag would decrease the photocatalytic activity of TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.

articleTitle: Technicial Research of Converter Duplex Melting Process with Low Hot Metal Ratio
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The present paper discusses the technical characteristics of the converter duplex melting process(MURC), develop one special converter duplex melting process with low hot metal ratio to meet the actual producing condition of Fujian Sangang steel group. Research show, how to promote the melting of lime during dephosphorizing period is the key step for MURC process. Adjusting the charging amount of lime according to the w([Si]) content in hot metal is helpful to control the melting of lime and the slag basicity. Under the condition of low hot metal ratio, in dephosphorizing period, must raise the melting temperature referring to the conventional process, lower the target slag basicity and w(T.Fe)suitably. According to results of the special MURC process industrial experiments, this process can meet the requirements on the producing of high-performance steel. Average tapping w([C]) is 0.183%, w([P]) is 0.0183%. The average dephosphorization rate is more than 90%. At the same time, referring to the conventional process, the special MURC process save the consumption of steel material about 2.3kg/tand save the consumption of lime 11.2kg/t averagely.

articleTitle: Probing into Application Mode of Digital Agriculture in Anhui Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: While informationization is now the main direction and objective of agricultural development, digital agriculture is the key technique to realize the agro-informationization and an important means to solve the present problems of "agriculture, farmer and rural area". In this paper, the development of digital agriculture in anhui province is discussed. Besides, some problems were pointed out. Further more, a application mode suitable for Anhui developing digital agriculture should be worked out.

articleTitle: Seismic Load Analysis of Wind Turbines by Response Spectrum Approach
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Wind energy is developing very fast in China and nowadays China owns the second largest wind power capacity in the world. A great number of wind turbines have been planted in the seismic active regions of China, for example, Beijing, Inner Mongolia. The seismic loads of these wind turbines need to be evaluated. In this paper, seven wind turbines are analyzed by the seismic response spectrum method, in which Chinese spectrum is applied. The base shear and base moment are calculated and the profiles of the shear and moment along the tower are investigated. Finally, the equations of the seismic loads are given, based on the numerical results.

articleTitle: The Influencing Factor on Test of Parameter of the Rock-Soil Thermal Properties
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: In this paper, the principle of a measuring device on thermal response test is introduced and a three-dimensional numerical model is developed. What's more, the effect of testing time, starting time point, ending time point and volumetric specific heat on the calculation results of the thermal response test by two variable parameter fitting method and three-dimensional numerical model are also discussed. It is validated that the volumetric specific heat is not sensitive to the thermal conductivity of the soil and has a little effect on borehole thermal resistance. The initial soil temperature, the end data point and start data point all affect the thermal conductivity and borehole thermal resistance to some extent. An enough length of testing time should be remained.

articleTitle: Comparison between Farmer Household Tourism Wastewater and Municipal Wastewater Based on 3DEEM Fluorescence Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Three-dimensional fluorescence spectrometry is a rapid analyzing method and is widely used in dissolved organic matter (DOM) characterizing and fingerprinting. In this present work, three-dimensional emission and excitation matrix (3DEEM) fluorescence spectrum was applied to characterize the fluorescence properties of dissolved organic matter in farmer household tourism wastewater and municipal wastewater. The results show that DOM fluorescence properties from various farmer household tourisms are characterized by protein-like; and high-excitation wavelength tryptophan-like peak is the strongest among all protein-like fluorescence peaks. Municipal wastewater also has same typical fluorescence peaks, while their fluorescence intensities are very relatively. Many protein-like fluorescence intensities of weir water are still close to it of municipal wastewater, though the wastewater is diluted and purified by the receiving waterbody. The polluting of wastewater from farmer household tourism to receiving waterbody shouldn't be ignored.

articleTitle: The Methods of Development Index Prediction Applicable to Low Permeability Reservoir
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Combining the features of low permeability reservoir water flood development and supposing that the formation was homogeneous and is opachous while the fluid was incompressible and gradually formed without considering the difference between densities of water and oil, this paper applies to Streamline Integration Method and Unit Analysis Principle on the basis of Low-Speed Non-Darcy Flow Formula obtained from in-house laboratory investigation, and finally derives the Index Prediction Mathematical Model considering the starting pressure gradient, which is reasonable and applicable to the development index prediction calculation of low permeability reservoir with the validation of oil field development actual data.

articleTitle: Hydrodynamics Performances in Cracking Furnace Tube with Twisted Slice: Experiments and Simulations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Employing air as fluid media, hydrodynamics performances in cracking furnace tube with twisted slice were studied, then the flow field (velocity, pressure drop, and resistance loss) of heat transfer enhancement was simulated based on CFX, at last, the effect of twist ratio on flow field was analyzed. The experimental results showed that boundary layer in the tube became thin compared with circular tube, which leaded to the increase of heat transfer coefficient. So heat transfer was enhanced. Axial velocity distribution in central area of the tube was smoother than that of circular tube, while velocity grad in near wall area was greater. Pressure drop increased in the tube, whereas pressure distribution was even along tube axis, in agreement with that in circular tube. The simulated results showed that tangential velocity increased rapidly while fluid flowed into the twisted slice, and then decreased gradually along tube axis and augmented gradually along tube diameter while fluid flowed out from the twisted slice. In the direction of the tube diameter, there existed a point where axial velocity was equal to the average axial velocity of the whole cross section. The whole pressure drop in the tube and local pressure drop in twisted slice section both rose with the increase of inlet velocity, and were independent of the tube diameter. Average resistance coefficient in the tube had a linear relationship with Reynolds number (Re), which reduced with the increase of Re. Local resistance loss in twisted slice section enhanced with the increase of Re and the decrease of the tube diameter. Twist ratio had an influence on the flow field in the tube, whose optimal numeric area was 2.4~2.6 in the studies.

articleTitle: Combustion and Heat Transfer Model Study on CFB Dense Zone under Oxygen-Enriched Combustion
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The heat transfer character of oxy-fired CFB boiler was studied, and a model of dense zone that considering the combustion and heat transfer is suggested. Through the model, heat transfer coefficient and its impact parameters in dense zone are studied. Some research are done with 30%, 50%,70% O2 conditions, and it was found that the heat transfer coefficient has no obvious change compared to common CFB boiler. The model takes a consideration of combustion condition in boiler, and offers a better reference for designing of CFB under oxygen-enriched combustion.

articleTitle: Structure and Ecological Benefits Evaluation of Street Trees in Shenyang Based on i-Tree (STRATUM) Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Sampling method was employed to investigate the structure and ecological benefits of street trees in the area within Second Ring Road of Shenyang. The study area covers about 161 km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and 61 main roads. Based on the field data, the i-Tree (STRATUM) model was run to analyze street trees' structure and ecological benefits. The results showed that there were 19 street tree species in the study area, which were belong to 13 families and 15 genera. The most common tree species are Sophora japonica, Populus alba, and Fraxinus chinensis, the percentage of which reached 68.32% of the total population. The proportion of small trees (d.b.h.

articleTitle: The Study of Treating Municipal Sewage by Using Sewer Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: When wastewater is collected and deliver to sewage treatment plant in sewer network, there are occurring complicate process about physical, chemical and biological. It has great impact to organic removal and transformation efficiency where happened during the later treatment process in sewage treatment plant. This essay will describe water quality change in sewer pipe and the technology by using sewer pipe or sewer networks to treat wastewater.

articleTitle: Method of Electromagnetic Frequency Spectrum and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Starting from the theory of MT, the paper gives an introduction for the current research status quo and the systematic principle of the high precision electromagnetic frequency spectrum(MES). It puts forward a linear relation that can be regarded as between exploring depth and electromagnetic frequency in local area, which makes it feasible that the stratum resistivity corresponds to the sounding line. A multichannel observation system using a paralleled capacitor as sensor is designed hereby to explore the resistivity of the underground ledge, which overcomes the disadvantage of Volume Effect and improves the prospecting precision. The system is applied to the exploration for the coal seam and the oil and gas. From the comparison of the practical hole-drilling data, the accordance has been given out a very good result with a figure of 80% or more.

articleTitle: Application of Heat Pump Distillation in Gas Separation Device
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Discusses research background and recent development condition of the heat pump technology, introduces the application forms of the heat pump distillation in the gas separation device. For the practical engineering application of gas separation device it establishes the thermal circulation system of the heat pump distillation process. Also it executes a detailed thermal calculation to the heat pump system, including the heat loads of the facilities, the system's coefficient of performance and the thermal energy consummation.

articleTitle: Experimental Study and System Optimization on Ground Source Heat Pump System in the Heating Mode
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The paper measures a ground source heat pump system which is running in the heating mode in a hotel in Hunan. And analyze how the circulation loop water flow influences the coefficient of performance of the heat pump units and the whole system. According to operating states of the ground source heat pump system, frequency conversion technology is purposed to be applied in the deep well pump so as to save much energy. The feasibility of the project is demonstrated in detail based on equivalent peak hour theory from energy saving property and static recycling period.

articleTitle: Studies on the Extraction of Phenol from the Wastewater of Multi-generation System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Recovery of phenol from the wastewater produced in the multi-cogeneration system has been studied. Based on the experimental results and theoretical analysis, butyl acetate was selected as the extractant and 99.95% of the volatile phenols in the wastewater was recovered in five stage extraction. The solvent recovery in the distillation column and the stripping column were also considered. Moreover, Aspen Plus was used for the simulation of the phenols extraction in the extraction column. Final result shows that phenol is much more difficult to be recovered because of its lower distribution coefficiency among the volatile phenols. The least solvent flow can also be found at different theoretical stages for the special environmental restrictions.

articleTitle: Enhancement Mechanism of SO2 on NO2 Removal by Calcium Hydroxide at Low Temperature
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Oxidizing NO to more soluble NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> has been proposed as a promising method for enhancing NO removal in conventional FGD processes. In this paper, the roles of gas components (O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O) and reaction temperature in NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> removal were discussed by comparing the NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> absorption characteristics in and without the presence of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. It was found that the presence of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in the flue gas could enhance NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> removal. The effects of O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O and reaction temperature had a high dependence on the presence of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. Without the presence of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O and O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> concentration had negligible influence on NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> removal, while higher reaction temperature could accelerate NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> absorption. However, reaction temperature did not affect NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> removal in the presence of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, and NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> removal increased with increasing relative humidity but decrease with O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> concentration increasing.

Author Keywords: flue gas components calcium based sorbent

articleTitle: The Virtual Prototype Design and Simulation of Litchi Fruit Flexible Picking Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Litchi fruit mechanized flexible picking could effectively solve the issue of the labor shortage at harvest time, and achieve high efficiency of harvesting fruit without injury, which have an important prospects of development and application. This paper designed a PP-RRR manipulator with S-joints DOF. By applying CAD graphic method, analyzed the structure size of manipulator in the height of 1-3 meters and the tree crown width of 4 meters in the flexible picking of litchi cluster-shaped fruit, built its mechanism and the virtual prototype model, in order to provide a technical support for the industrialization development of litchi harvesting intelligent equipment.

articleTitle: Unsupported Ni-Mo Composite Oxide Catalysts Prepared by Sol-gel Method for Hydrodeoxygenation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Unsupported Ni-Mo composite oxide catalysts were successfully prepared by the sol-gel method with citric acid as a complex agent. The catalysts were characterized using N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> adsorption-desorption, X-ray diffraction (XRD) and temperature programmed desorption (NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-TPD). The effects of Mo/Ni molar ratio and reaction temperature on the hydrodeoxygenation activity of the catalysts were investigated emphatically using acetic acid and phenol as probe compounds. The results showed that the catalysts prepared by the sol-gel method can possess higher specific surface area and the double mesoporous structure. The β-NiMoO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> phase determined by XRD was existed in the catalysts. For Mo/Ni molar ratios between 0.0 ~ 0.8, the pore volume, the specific surface area, the medium strong acidity and hydrodeoxygenation activity of the catalyst are not monotonically increasing functions of Mo/Ni ratio. The catalyst with Mo/Ni ratio of 0.6 exhibited the highest hydrodeoxygenation activity. At 0.3MPa, the deoxygenation percentage of the phenol was 99.0% at 210°C and 99.9% at 270°C for the acetic acid, respectively.

articleTitle: Design Analysis of the Selection of the Four Main Pipelines of the 1000MW Ultra Supercritical Unit
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Pipelines for the main steam, hot sections of the reheat steam, cold sections of the reheat steam and the high pressure feed water are main constitutes of the power plant boiler. Material selection of the four main pipelines will have significant impact on the security and economy of the power plant operation. The pressure of the main steam of the 1000MW ultra supercritical unit in Tianjin SDIC Jinneng Electric Power CO.LTD is 27.56 MPa, and the temperature of the main steam is 605°C. It brings forward the high requirement of the mechanical characteristic and high temperature performance of the four main pipelines. Demonstration is processed considering the thermal stress, coefficient of the heat expansion, operation reliability and the economy, and the compositions of the four main pipeline material are selected.

articleTitle: Organic and Nutrients Removal by 5 Aquatic Plants in Simulated Constructed Wetland
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: In order to study the contaminant removal characteristics of constructed wetlands (CWs) under high loadings, the performance of CWs planted with Arrowhead, Alisma, Monochoria korsakowii, Thalia dealbata and Oenan the were investigated, respectively, to determine the effects of plants in contaminant removal and for wetland plant selection. The experiment was conducted by sequencing batch feed, with the initial ammonia nitrogen(NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N), total phosphorus(TP)and chemical oxygen demand (COD) concentration of 37.7mg/L, 2.1 mg/L and 71.6 mg/L, respectively. The results showed that, for TP removal, the highest removal efficiency of 79.01% was acquired in Arrowhead treatment, while other plants treatment showed little difference from unplanted control. For NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N removal, all planted treatments showed superior removal rates than unplanted control, the highest removal rate of 63.67% was also acquired in Arrowhead treatment. For the COD removal, the removal rate of treatments all reached 40%-70% and planted treatments performed better than the control treatment, especially for Arrowhead. Generally speaking, Arrowhead was the best plant for CWs under high loadings. Plant factors played an important role in contaminant removal processes of CWs.

articleTitle: Electronic Differential Control with Vehicle State Observer Based on Extended Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The growing demands for high level of energy efficiency have given much new impetus to the development of electric vehicle in Agricultural Machines. To improve the performance of the state observer for an 8-DOF four-wheel vehicle, a state observer based on the Extended Kalman Filter is proposed. With the observer, the tire-road forces and the vehicle roll velocity are estimated accurately according to the simulation results. With the consideration of the nonlinear characters of tire and electric vehicle, the electronic differential controller is proposed to select the wheel slip ratios as the control tracking variables and distribute the torques to ensure the steering stability by using modified exponent approaching sliding mode control method. The proposed electronic differential controller is robust to improve the handling performance and control response of electric vehicle with the numerical verification.

articleTitle: Chinese Industrial Energy Efficiency Evaluation Considering Carbon Emissions
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Data envelopment analysis (DEA) is effective to evaluate energy efficiency, but few studies use this technique considering carbon emissions. This paper measures Chinese industrial sector's energy efficiency considering carbon emissions based on the slack-based measure (SBM) model in 1997-2008. The results show that Chinese industrial energy efficiency is relatively low, the average scores (SBM-based) fluctuated between 0.26 and 0.35, and the trend is decreasing gradually. By Comparative analysis, prove that SBM model considering undesirable outputs can better assess energy efficiency and the level of industrial low-carbon development, the last six sectors' energy efficiency are extremely low and have great potentiality for improvement.

articleTitle: Study on Treatment of Mine Water and Its Cost Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: During the process of coal production, mine water pollution is serious. It will become a threat to ecological environment in coal mining area if this kind of water is drained away to the nature directly. Take Jialong coal mine as an example, we analyzed major qualities of mine water, provided specific process of treatment of mine water, and demonstrated the feasibility, effectiveness, cost of mine water disposal technology. The result showed to us that the process adopted is effective in removing the sewage from mine water, such as CODCr, SS, Fe, Mn. The treated water meets the standards of emission or recycling and its cost is low too. So this process has great promotional value.

articleTitle: Degradation of Methylene Blue Using Sunlight with Fixed and Suspended Ag/TiO2 Photocatalyst
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: In this work, Ag/TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> photo catalyst was prepared by depositing elemental Ag on the surface of TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> particle surface. Ag was got by reducing ion Ag<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> in the suspension of TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> with illumination of UV light. When it was used to degrade ethylene blue (MB) using UV light, Ag/TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gave higher catalytic activity than TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. To examine the influence of existing type of catalyst on photo degradation of organic compounds using sunlight, MB was degraded using solar energy with Ag/TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> fixed and suspended separately. Experimental results indicates that it has not much more advantages to degrade organic compounds with catalyst suspended in solution than fixed on somewhere in reactor under the condition of fixing the treating amount of solution per unit time, although the time needed by suspended catalyst is less than that by fixed catalyst for degrading MB to the same concentration. At first, the recovery processing of catalyst will increase the expense. Secondly, the time needed by fixing type TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> will decrease by increasing the reaction area. So, it is necessary to set much more attention on the designing of sunlight photo catalytic reactor with fixing type catalyst. Key words: photo catalyst, sunlight, fix, suspend.

articleTitle: Effect of Mechanical-Biological Pretreatment on the Characteristics of MSW in China: A Thermogravimetric Assessment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: MBT is a relevant method used as a pretreatment technique for MSW, especially for the MSW with high organic content and high moisture content. As the MBT method can greatly reduce the weight and water content of MSW, the properties and combustion characteristics of original and treated MSW would be very different. The treated MSW has a lower weight and moisture content compared to the original. The total weigh decreases by 30% and the percentage of water decreases by 16%. Meanwhile, percentages of combustible contents increase by 13%. Changes in the concentrations of treated MSW result in a high LHV of 7362 kJ kg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> while the LHV of original MSW is 2468 kJ kg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. Larger particles of treated MSW have a much higher volatile matter content, but a lower fixed carbon content and ash content. As for the LHV, it was declined with diameters. TGA is used here to evaluate the effect of MBT on the combustion characteristics of MSW. Results of TGA show that with the exception of one original MSW sample, other samples all have three peaks in their DTG curves with the maximum DTG values approximately occur at 290°C, 440°C and 650°C, respectively.

articleTitle: Effect of Phenol on Enhanced Treatment of Sewage from Discharging Points of Rivers by Biofilm Process Dosing with Enzyme
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The research studied enhanced treatment of sewage from discharging points of rivers by biofilm process dosing with enzyme and the effect of phenol on removal rates of the main pollution indexes, and investigated promotion effect of enzyme (including the laboratory developed compounded enzyme and the foreign composite enzyme) on treatment of sewage by biofilm process. The research results indicated that when initial concentration of phenol was 1mg/L, the removal rate of phenol in three reactors was above 97%, and phenol had no negative effect on the removal rates of COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Cr</sub> and ammonia nitrogen, which indicated that phenol (1mg/L) had no poisonous effects on microorganisms. Moreover, enzyme had good promotion effect on biofilm process during the sewage treatment process.

articleTitle: Study on Screening of Dominant Bacteria for Phenol Degradation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Three dominant bacteria of A-1, B-1 and C-1 for phenol degradation were screened by domestication. Then study on the treatment efficiency of phenol by the three dominant bacteria was carried out under different concentration of phenol wastewater. The results showed that phenol removal efficiency decreased as the phenol concentration increasing. The phenol removal efficiency rates achieved 46.74%, 51.43% and 23.08% by A-1, B-1 and C-1 in 24 h when phenol concentration was 50 mg·L-1, and 70.22%,75.19% and 20.43% when concentration was 100 mg·L-1. The best degradation efficiency achieved by the bacterium B-1. Lastly, effect of reaction time, pH and temperature on phenol degradation with B-1 was studied. The result showed when reaction time was 48h, pH was 7, temperature was 30°C, phenol and COD removal efficiency achieved about 50% and 30%, respectively.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Adsorption of Sulfate with CTAB Modified Zeolit from Environmental Water Sample
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Organic zeolite (CTAB-Z) was modified with cationic surfactant-cetyltrimethylammonium bromide (CTAB) in this study under the following conditions: CTAB concentration 1.0% (wt%), modification temperature 25°C, modification time two hours and used to remove SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> from water and wastewater as adsorbent. Some factors which influence the removal ratio of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> from water sample such as mesh size of CTAB-Z, dosage, contact adsorption time and adsorption temperature were investigated. And L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sub>(3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>) orthogonal table was made in order to determine the order of the factors from their importance during SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> removal. The results show that dosage of CTAB-Z is the uppermost factor which influence the removal of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> directly, adsorption temperature is secondary, and contact adsorption time is third. Meanwhile, the removal ratio of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> could exceed 59% when the operating conditions are as following: mesh size of CTAB-Z is 80 mesh, dosage is 20g/L, contact adsorption time is two hours and adsorption temperature is 40°C.

articleTitle: A New Measurement Method for Cavity Diameter of Porous Concrete
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The cavity diameter is an important parameter to denote the characteristic of porous concrete. So far, the information about the measurement of cavity diameter of porous concrete is quite insufficient. Especially, the direct measuring method was seldom reported. In the study, a new method to measure the cavity diameter by applying Integrate Charge-Coupled Detector (CCD) imaging technology was developed. The method was simple, time and money spending less and effective. In terms of the method, the mean cavity diameters of porous concretes made by coarse aggregates of 5-10mm,10-16mm, 16-20mm, 20-25mm and 25-32mm were 3.20mm, 4.33 mm, 6.70 mm, 7.75 mm and 9.65mm, respectively. Both void ratio and permeability coefficient of pore concrete were affected by cavity diameter.

Author Keywords: Integrate Charge-Coupled Detector (CCD) imaging technology Method

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Far Infrared and Cross Flow Combination Heating System for Vegetables Drying
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Based on the shortcomings of hot air with the material contact area was small and other problems in the current advection combination heating vegetables dehydrator, has carried on the improvement of cross-flow supply the wind technology. The technology of air-supply and air-induced at single side was adopted, facilitated the general layout of the equipment, the technology of air-supply at two ends and variable cross-section, enhanced the longitudinal and crosswise uniformity of air-supply, the common punching plate structure of conveying chain plate was adopted, which has met the request of two-sided transportation at the cross-flow supply the wind. Based on this, has carried on the dehydrated drying experiment for cabbage and carrot, it was indicated that comparing with single far infrared radiation heating, saving energy consumption 17.9% and 14.2% respectively when the cross-flow combination heating was adopted. This article has laid a good foundation for this equipment's further study and industrial production.

articleTitle: Enthalpy Transfer Analysis & Calculation about Heat and Moisture Exchanger Process during Air Flowing on Water-Film Channel of Cooling Pad
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Aiming at the process characteristic about heat and moisture exchanger process during air flowing on water-film channel of cooling pad, we gave a proposal that the process was regarded as enthalpy transfer process, and then, the concept of enthalpy degree of moisture air and water-film was defined basing on the idea of potential different action. By analogy of heat transfer, enthalpy transfer was analyzed and one dimension enthalpy transfer model during air flowing water-film channel was built, and a calculation example was introduced linking practical application. The results are shown that this theory analysis and calculation way is brief and practical, especially, for the product development of water evaporation cooling fan.

articleTitle: Theoretical Indicators for Proposing Reductive Dechlorination Pathways of Polychlorinated Dibenzo-p-dioxins and Dibenzofurans
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Density functional theory (DFT) calculations were carried out at the B3LYP/6-31G(d) level for all polychlorinateddibenzo-p-dioxins and dibenzofurans (PCDD/Fs). Mulliken atomic charge on chlorine atom (Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Cl(n)</sub>) and molecular total energy (E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</sub>) were adopted as the theoretical indicators of the dechlorination reaction activity. The hypothesis was that the preferred reaction pathways would either yield dominant daughter products having the lowest ET, or occur in the substituted chlorine atom having the largest Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Cl(n)</sub>. The predicted pathways were validated with literature data on the biotic dechlorination of 1,2,3,4-TCDD and the biotic reductive dechlorination pathways for 1,2,3,4-TCDD, 1,2,3,7,8-PeCDD,1,2,3,4,7,8-HxCDF. Results showed the a biotic reactions with zero-valent zinc and biotic transformations by Dehalococcoidessp. strain CBDB1 followed the pathways eliminating chlorine atom having the largest Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Cl(n)</sub>, but the biotic transformations by Dehalococcoides ethenogenes strain 195 followed the pathways that favored the lowest E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</sub> products.

articleTitle: Thermaleconomic Analysis of Supercritical Compressed Air Energy System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: In this paper, the economy of supercritical compressed air energy system is evaluated by using thermal economic method. Electricity price of input system to evaluate selects by the beijing municipal market price for peak and valley, and uses Engineering Equation Solver software to simulate. The results show that the electricity price of output is 0.5153 RMB/kW·h, while electricity price of input system is 0.3148 RMB/kW·h by 35 kV valley market price, there is obvious economic advantages compared to the peak market price. This system has no CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and other greenhouse gas emission comparing with the compressed air energy storage system, it can also reach the purpose of regulating network load and improve renewable energy power system efficiency, so it has significant environmental and economic advantages.

articleTitle: Performance-Based Design Applied Analysis of Large-Scale Commercial Complexes
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: With the urbanized development, large-scale commercial complexes emerge rapidly in which many constructive shapes and formats distribution exist. However, the current design of fire protection code is unable to stipulate them. Although it really resolved many difficulties in the engineering practice using the performance of fire protection design, it has also brought many problems like circumventing the standard requirement, derating fire load by choosing fire scenes at will, reducing safety standards due to depending on the management excessively, choosing technical parameter randomly, losing contact with reality in the evaluation analysis and so on. So people need to put forward the control of performance design application scope after analyzing some performance-based design cases of some large-scale commercial complexes, to determine the security goal combining the condition of our country and the safety management, to select the fire scenes objectively and actually and to formulate and improve the current standards after summarizing the performance design measures of the indoor commercial pedestrian streets and the large and middle-scale atriums even the common architectural shapes.

articleTitle: Utilization of CFBC Ashes as Road Base Material
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Nowadays there is a large quantities of ash discharged from coal-fired fluidized-bed combustion boilers that has a low utilization rate. The road base material made of CFBC ashes can make use of large quantities solid waste and educe mining of natural stone and soil, which has obvious economic and social benefits. It also would be useful for the environment. There would be an enormous demand for such road base material. A simple and low-cost road base material production process has, therefore, been developed where the CFBC ash is mixed with, fly-ash and water. This paper discusses the conditions of road base construction and the road performance test results.

articleTitle: Design of Acoustical System of Circulatory Multi-step Ultrasonic Reactor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Traditional reactor has many disadvantages such as low efficiency, complicated structure and unstable system, which are unfavourable to chemical production. This paper introduces the design principle of acoustical system of circulatory multi-step ultrasonic reactor. According to the chemical reaction, the acoustical system was designed and analyzed by FEM software. Theoretical analysis results indicate that frequency and mechanical properties of the acoustical system reach the expectant demand.

articleTitle: Relationship between Ecosystem Carbon Fluxes and Canopy Radiometric Temperature Using Infrared Thermometry in a Ryegrass Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Using the closed chamber technique daily changes of net ecosystem carbon dioxide (CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) exchange (NEE) and ecosystem respiration (R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sub>) were determined in a ryegrass ecosystem on eight separated days at half hour interval from morning to afternoon in Taiyuan basin, Shanxi province of China. The gross primary production (GPP) was calculated as the difference of NEE and R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sub>. The objective of the study was to examine the relationship between ecosystem C fluxes and canopy temperature (T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub>), air temperature (T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</sub>) and soil temperature (T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub>), and finally to explore the possibility that T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub> could substitute T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</sub> or T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub> for estimate of ecosystem carbon fluxes. The results showed on diurnal scales that the coefficients of determination of both NEE and GPP with T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub> were significantly higher than those of the GPP and NEE with T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</sub>, and that the R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sub> was also closely related with both T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</sub> and T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub> on all measurement dates, but that significant correlation of R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sub> with T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub> existed only on 7 out of 8 measurement dates. The determination coefficients between R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sub> and T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub> were lower than those between R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sub> and both T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</sub> and T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub> on diurnal scales. These results suggested that at plot scale T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub> also is a good factor for ecosystem carbon fluxes estimate as both T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</sub> and T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub> factors. This gives some implications for linking remotely sensed infrared temperature of canopy to ecosystem carbon flux estimate. However, further experiments at ecosystem scale are still needed.

articleTitle: Research on Parameter Estimation Method and Equilibrium Point of Mathematical Model for Thermal Power Unit
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: According to the structure of thermal power plant unit, and combining the dynamic relationship between the various parameters, a parameter estimation technique in vacuum state for mathematical model of the boiler-turbine units is proposed, which based on the modern control theory and previous research results. At the same time we try to give an analysis method of the mathematical model with equilibrium points in this paper, at last the reliability and applicability of the method is proved through a practical example.

articleTitle: Study on Water Requirements of Liuzhou Ecological City Construction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: This paper calculated and analyzed the water requirements of Liuzhou ecological city construction, combining with the eco-city planning of Liuzhou. The results showed that water requirements of Liuzhou ecological city construction was wavelike raised gradually, the water requirements of final ecological city construction will reach100.32 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. Development and utilization level of water resources will be 0.406, which the urban, Liujiang, Rongan were 1.529, 0.425 and 0.410 relatively. The water resource was over-exploitation, while water requirement was mainly used for forestland water requirement, agricultural water requirement and industrial water requirement. Therefore, it was vital to save water. The residents' water consumption and green space water consumption were relatively few, but the increase amplitudes was much higher. Hereby, it is crucial to give some suggestions and measures of water resource conservation and utilization on Liuzhou ecological city construction.

articleTitle: Effect of Modification Conditions on Synthesis Polyamide/Attapulgite Composite Material
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Using solution polymerization, we have success synthesized PAM/ATP adsorbent by grafting acryl amide (AM)onto the γ-Methacryloxypropyl trimethoxy silane (KH-570)modified ATP (OATP). We carried out a series of experiments to find KH-570 modification of the optimal conditions. Results showed that KH-570 modification of the proper conditions is:KH-570 dosage 5ml (relative to 6g ATP), modification time 4h, modification temperature 60°C. Thermal behavior and the structure of the materials were characterized by thermo gravimetric analysis (TGA), Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), and X-ray diffraction (XRD).

articleTitle: Adsorption of 2, 4, 6-Trinitrotoluene on Aminoalky Cellulose in a Fixed Bed Column
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The adsorption performance of aminoalky cellulose (AmAC) for 2,4,6-trinitrotoluene (TNT) was investigated in a fixed bed column. The fixed bed column parameters such as bed height, flow rate, influent TNT concentration were studied by a series of dynamic adsorption experiments. The result showed AmAC was an effective adsorbent for removal of TNT, and the equilibrium uptake increased from 27.76 to 36.18 mg/g when the bed height increased from 4.5 to 7.3 cm at flow rate of 10 mL/min and influent TNT concentration of 20 mg/L. The equilibrium uptake decreased from 3 8.01 to 22.03 mg/L with increasing of flow rate from 10 to 20 mL/min. As influent concentration increased from 20 to 80 mg/L, the equilibrium uptake increased from 31.69 to 52.20 mg/g. The minimum column height of 2.3 cm was calculated by the bed depth service time (BDST) at flow rate of 10 mL/min and influent TNT concentration of 20 mg/L.

articleTitle: Modified Pyrolytic Carbon Black from Scrap Tires and Its Reinforcement Performance in Natural Rubber
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Carbon blacks are the most widely used reinforcing fillers. The raw material of carbon black manufacture depends on petroleum industry to a great extent. Reclamation of used tires is to be enormously significant as oil will be used up in the near future. Pyrolytic carbon black (PCB) is one of the most important products from the pyrolysis of scrap tires. One of the most essential applications for modified PCB is to reinforce the rubber matrix to obtain extra values. High inorganic ash content and a large amount of carbonaceous deposits on the surface of PCB confirmed by atomic force microscopy (AFM) are the two main barriers for PCB further application. Adsorption layer with an adequately thick could not be formed on the surface of PCB because of the lack of effective active sites. Techniques for PCB modification have been developed. The rubber vulcanization and reinforcement properties of pyrolytic and modified carbon black were investigated and compared with those of commercial carbon black The cross link structure, relaxation and self-diffusion properties were investigated by solid-state high resolution nuclear magnetic resonance respectively. Demineralization and modification with NDZ-105 titanate coupling agent not only intensify the interactions between carbon black and the neighboring polyisoprene chains, but also increase the chemical cross-link density of the vulcanized rubber with TWPC. TWPC could be used to replace the commercial semi-reinforcing carbon black.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of Performance of Dehumidification Cooling on Metal Packing Surface
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The performance of dehumidification cooling on the metal packing surface was studied with numerical methods. A mathematical model describing heat and mass transfer performance of dehumidification cooling on the metal packing surface was set up. The numerical solution of differential equations was derived. Taking the heat and mass transfer coefficients obtained by experiments as the input parameters of the model, the temperature distribution of air and water flow on the packing surface was described. The simulation results corresponds very well to experimental data. Simulation results indicated that the mathematical model could be used to predict the performance of dehumidification cooling on metal packing surface. The results showed that the mathematical model can be of great value in the design and improvement of metal packing for air conditioning equipment.

articleTitle: Study on Screening Method of Bio-demulsifying Microorganism from Activated Sludge and Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Bio-demulsifier as a biological agent will become a substitute of chemical demulsifier for its high efficiency, low cost, high adoptability and environment friendly. In this paper, a set of high efficiency, rapid and simple method was established to isolate de emulsification strains. Blue-gel plates test, oil agar plates test, oil-spreading test and demulsifying test were combined used in this method. Using this method, ten strains with high de-emulsification capability which the demulsifying ratios in O/W Kerosene emulsion (in 24h) were more than 50% were primary screened from activated sludge samples. Two highly efficient demulsifying strains which the demulsifying ratio in O/W Kerosene emulsion (in 24h) were more than 90% were secondary isolated and identified as Gordonia sp through 16S rDNA gene and physiological test. The whole culture of the strain appeared very high deemulsification activity with low biomass.

articleTitle: Accumulation and Distribution of PAHs in Organo-mineral Aggregates of Oil Contaminated Site
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Soil samples in different depths we recollected from Tiebutie pool in Daqing, which was used to take up waste water from a petrochemical plant for about 30 years. The distribution and concentration of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons(PAHs) in organo-mineral aggregates were analyzed. Results show that the concentration of low molecular PAHs is the highest in all fractions, and the concentration of low molecular PAHs is higher than that of high molecular PAHs in deeper soil. PAHs concentration in clay fraction is the highest, and the concentration of PAHs is related to the content of soil organic matter. Adsorption is an important transport approach for PAHs inorgano-mineral aggregates.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Production of Common Sintered Bricks Containing High Volume of Waterworks Sludge
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The production of common sintered brick by using waterworks sludge and fly ash as major raw materials with the addition of feldspar powder and quartz sand is studied. The apparent natures, compressive strength, water absorption and other performance tests of the bricks are investigated. The results indicate that 60%-70% of waterworks sludge can be used to produce common sintered bricks. The water absorption is about 20% and the compressive strength is higher than 20MPa, which meet the National Standards(GB/T5101-2003).

articleTitle: Environmental Influencing Factors of Permeability on Contaminative Aquifer Medium by Ethanol Blended Gasoline
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Different ethanol concentration of gasoline components have a significant influence on the permeability of aquifer medium. Because the different of pollutant concentrations will change the environment of aquifer medium, bring on jamming the pore space of medium and influence the hydraulic conductivity and bioremediation of pollutants in aquifer. This study focuses the environmental influencing factors of permeability on contaminated porous medium via four sand columns experiments. Results show that environmental influencing factors of permeability are dissolved oxygen, temperature, PH value and conductivity, and the dissolved oxygen is the main influencing factor of permeability.

articleTitle: Study of Depth Profile Control by Swellable Pre-crosslinking Particle Gel
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The sellable pre-cross linking particle gel is a kind of surface cross linking pre-polymer, of which the effects of several important factors like temperature, salinity and the pH values on its swellable performance, visco-elasticity, thermal stability and enhanced oil recovery ratio were firstly evaluated. Then the NMR, an advanced visible technology, was used to represent the oil and water distribution laws in different core displacement processes by water, polymer and the swellable particle gel. The results show that the depth profile control agent used in this study has great strength, excellent salt resistance and thermal stability, and controllable particle radius, swelling rate and ratio. It can deviate the water flow direction at the high permeability formation to displace much of the remaining oil at the low permeability reservoirs.

articleTitle: Inhibitory Effect of Streptomycin on Methane Production of Anaerobic Granular Sludge
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The inhibitory effect of streptomycin on methane production of anaerobic granular sludge treating starch wastewater was investigated. The results indicated that the methane production of anaerobic granular sludge was influenced in the presence of streptomycin ranged from 0 to120 mg/L. The larger final methane production, the less remaining COD and the higher final pH value at the end of tests were obtained at streptomycin concentration range varying from 5 mg/L to 40 mg/L, compared with these in control batches or at other higher streptomycin concentrations, indicating that the methane production depended on the multiple inhibitory effects of streptomycin on both acetogenic bacteria and methanogens being responsible for bioconversion of organic matter to methane. On the other hand, the inhibitory effect of streptomycin on methanogenesis seemed predominant in the initial 24 h. The initial methane production rates decreased with an increase in streptomycin concentration, which was simulated using Logistic model. The low half inhibitory concentration of streptomycin for methane production was obtained as 2.054 mg/L, indicating relatively strong inhibitory effect of streptomycin on methanogenesis of anaerobic granular sludge under this study conditions.

articleTitle: Thermodynamic Comparison between Thermoelectric Refrigerator and Compression Ones
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The thermodynamic properties were compared between thermoelectric refrigerator and compression ones. The irreversible losses of a thermoelectric refrigerating system represent the typical losses of general two-source refrigerating system. Its finite heat transfer, Joule heat and Fourier heat are respectively corresponding to the irreversible heat transfer, friction and heat leak of compressing refrigerating system. COPs varying with refrigerating capacity are qualitatively alike between a thermoelectric refrigerator and a compression one. The optimum working spot should be (εq)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub>, namely, the product of refrigerating coefficient and capacity should be maximum.

articleTitle: Benefit Analyses of Soil and Water Conservation: A Case Study in a Hilly Red Soil Area in Southeast China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Eight measures of soil and water conservation(SWC) have successfully carried out for developing sustainable agriculture systems in hilly red soil region in southeast China since 2000. Economical, ecological and social benefits are assessed in this study to determine efficiency of these measures. All measures have shown a positive net present value of direct benefits in the computing period when an interest rate 10% used. And an evaluation system for comparing efficiencies of these measures have been built, indictors such us economical effects, payback period time, changes in soil erosion rates, nutrient content, microclimate, and social benefits are recommended. Forest enclosure, embankments, and biomass pools are the most economically measures with a short payback period while low efficiency forest reform, fruit trees planting and shifting slope to terrace measures had remarkable effects on reducing soil erosion and protecting soil and water resource, pear trees can be replaced by other cash crops to avoid long payback period.

articleTitle: Removal Hg from Simulated Coal Fuel Gas over Sulfided Iron-Based Sorbent
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Iron oxide sorbent TG-1 used effectively in industry and its sulfided sorbent TG-l-S are selected as the samples for experiments of Hg removal. A fixed packed bed reactor is used under different temperature and ambient atmosphere. The results show that the discarded sulfided iron oxide sorbent can be sequentially used removing mercury from coal gas and it is one of efficient and valuable capturing Hg methods. Sulfur or FeSχ in TG l-S sorbent can react with elemental mercury to form stable mercury sulfide, and this cause much higher removal Hg capacity than fresh iron oxide sorbent TG-1 in N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. The optimum temperature range of removing Hg for TG-l-S sorbent is 100-120°C. CO and H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in inlet gas have the negligible effect, H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S has promoting action for removal mercury with TG-l-S sorbent. In the simulation of coal gas atmosphere, sulfided iron oxide sorbent TG l-S has higher removing Hg capacity of 3.9 mg /g Hg capacity and the removal efficiency of 95%.

articleTitle: Establishment of a Methodology to Guide Energy-efficient Renovation of Existing Residential Buildings in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Energy-efficient renovation has been accepted widely as the best solution for upgrading existing residential buildings. In order to guide such real projects in China and maximize the benefits in energy, environmental and economic fields from the activities, in this article a methodology is developed for decision-makers to assist the design of energy efficient renovation plan in the early stage of design phase. Following the methodology, a suitable energy-efficient renovation plan, integrating all effective and available energy saving measures and as well as excluding all useless and/or unfeasible ones, is put forward for subject building and its effects on the reduction of energy use, CO2 emission and cost are evaluated accurately.

articleTitle: Supersonic Ejector to Boost Production from Low Pressure Natural Gas Field
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: An effective way to boost natural gas production from low pressure gas field was introduced in the paper. The supersonic ejector used the energy of high pressure gas wells, which was generally wasted through the choke valve, as its power supply to boost the low pressure gas production. The field experiment of the natural gas ejector was carried out, and the performance of the ejector was also presented. Moreover, the production of low pressure natural gas well was compared when the natural gas ejector was used or not. The economic analysis shows that the recovery period of the capital was less than several months.

articleTitle: A Heat Energy Assessment Method of the Plant Secondary Effluent as Cold and Heat Sources for Heat Pump
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The sewage plant secondary effluent is full of low cold and heat energy, drawing cold and heat energy by direct sewage source heat pump and using it can provide heating in winter and cooling in summer. This paper introduced technical solutions of the direct sewage source heat pump system, besides, it gave the evaluating method of sewage effluent cold and heat energy ¨C the hourly analysis method, taking a sewage plant in Qingdao as an example and comparing it with the common engineering assessment method, the results show that this method has more engineering practicability.

articleTitle: Effect of Trace NO2 and Kinetic Characteristics for Anaerobic Ammonium Oxidation, Methanogenesis, Denitrification and Their Integration of Granular Sludge
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The effect of trace NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> on anaerobic ammonium oxidation, methanogenesis and denitrification in separate system was investigated by batch experiment. Trace NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> apparently enhanced the anaerobic ammonium oxidation, the function for NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> apparently to enhance ammonium oxidation was suggested using the Haldane based model. The parameters were estimated, where the half saturate coefficient of NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> was 2570 mg/L, inhibition coefficient of NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> was 0.0039 mg/L, the maximum enhanced rate coefficient was 48.79, the basic rate coefficient was 0.0188.The effect of NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> on methanogenesis and denitrification kinetics could be described using uncompetitive inhibition model. The maximum COD removal rate, half saturation constant of organic substance and NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> inhibition coefficient in methanogenesis were 0.149 mgCOD (mgVSS-h) -1, 396mgCOD/L and 0.231 mg NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> /L, respectively. The maximum nitrite removal rate, half saturation constant of NO-2-N and NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> inhibition coefficient in denitrification were 0.006865h-1, 0.1 mg NO-2-N /L and 1530 mg NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> /L, respectively. The effect of trace NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> integrating methanogenesis, denitrification and anaerobic ammonium oxidation was investigated by batch experiment. Also, the function for NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> apparently to enhance ammonium oxidation was suggested by the Haldane based model. The parameters were estimated, where the half saturate coefficient of NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> was 1.96 mg/L, inhibition coefficient of NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> was 0.0082 mg/L, the maximum enhanced rate coefficient was 3055, the basic rate coefficient was 0.0314. The effect of trace NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> on methanogenesis and denitrification kinetics could be described by uncompetitive inhibition model. The maximum COD removal rate, half saturation constant of organic substance and NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> inhibition coefficient in methanogenesis were 0.15mgCOD /(mgVSS-h), 395mgCOD /L and 0.623 mg NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> /L respectively. The maximum nitrite removal rate, half saturation constant of NO-2-N and NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> inhibition coefficient in denitrification were 0.00685 h-1, 0.214 mg NO-2-N /L and 22.4mg NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> /L respectively. The most of NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> in the experiment was lossed.

articleTitle: Adsorption of Nitrogen and Phosphorus on Natural Zeolite and Its Influencing Factors
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The ammonia nitrogen and phosphorus adsorption on natural zeolite were studied.
